basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 14.' and it opens 'Vers. 14. Leva oculos. Id est, aspice. Per haec quatuor climata terra promissionis ei'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 14. Leva oculos. Id est, aspice. Per haec quatuor climata terra promissionis ei promittitur. Quod autem in quibusdam locis mare ponitur pro Occidente, ideo fit quia terra repromissionis in mari Occidentali est.
